verdict.rationale: The only on-topic evidence is a community comment confirming a public status page exists at status.aws.amazon.com. The same comment reports that the page showed all services green during a major us-east-1 outage, which undercuts the 'real status surface' part of the story. The pack has no first-party documentation of the status page, so there is no vendor claim for that report to dispute. Missing for 10: first-party docs for the status/health dashboard, per-service incident history, published post-incident reports, and evidence the page accurately reflects outages.
